g.text: Modular animated SVG profile and CV engine for developer showcases
Slot-machine keyframe roll-in animations for repos,
stars, followers & forks without client scripts.
Vector layout with animated gradient shaders,
Pulsing radar indicator highlighting your latest
active repository with humanized activity time.
Scheduled daily updates directly on GitHub Actions.
Zero 3rd-party hosting proxies, never goes down.
Local icon scanner and Devicon cloud resolver with
instant Base64 encoding into a 4x2 chip grid.
Generated assets stay strictly inside build/ folder.
Zero clutter, automated target repository deployment.
# 2. Install minimal CLI dependencies & launch interactive setup studio
Drop .svg, .png, or .jpg files into GitFlex/icons/. The engine converts them into Base64 data URIs automatically.
